payload.summary: Planned roadmap item ri-03 as an outcome-only supervisor execution path over the existing synchronous dispatch_fn result seam. The approved design uses scope-safe prepared batches, isolated background Autopilot children, an acknowledgement/go lease protocol, and bounded structured outcomes.

decisions.title: Use inherited roadmap approvals
decisions.rationale: The operator's explicit autopilot-roadmap invocation approved discovery, direction, and the final per-item plan, so no duplicate item-level gate was required.

decisions.title: Separate prepare from synchronous result application
decisions.rationale: prepare_delegated_batch persists exact envelopes without invoking dispatch_fn; apply_delegated_batch invokes the existing synchronous callback once per collected generation result, keeping Autopilot as the sole phase-machine owner.

decisions.title: Gate child entry on durable acknowledgement
decisions.rationale: A generation-specific go barrier prevents Autopilot entry before handle persistence; pre-go claims are CAS-reclaimable, while unknown post-go liveness quarantines until positive reconciliation evidence exists.

decisions.title: Fail closed on scope and context ambiguity
decisions.rationale: Only proven-disjoint all-package scopes may fan out, and both request and checkpoint context use the shared recursively bounded secret-rejecting contract.

next_steps: Implement package wp-contracts first with failing fixtures for state, context, and isolation invariants.
Preserve the one-way neutral scheduler to orchestrator to host-adapter dependency direction.
Run the two-child host-event capture and recursive runtime-mirror gates before completion.
